symbols.name: Voiceless bilabial plosive
symbols.description: Voiceless oral stop produced with both lips.

symbols.name: Voiced bilabial plosive
symbols.description: Voiced oral stop produced with both lips.

symbols.name: Voiceless alveolar plosive
symbols.description: Voiceless oral stop produced with the tongue tip or blade at the alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Voiced alveolar plosive
symbols.description: Voiced oral stop produced with the tongue tip or blade at the alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Voiceless retroflex plosive
symbols.description: Voiceless oral stop produced with the tongue tip curled back toward the hard palate.

symbols.name: Voiced retroflex plosive
symbols.description: Voiced oral stop produced with the tongue tip curled back toward the hard palate.

symbols.name: Voiceless palatal plosive
symbols.description: Voiceless oral stop produced with the body of the tongue against the hard palate.

symbols.name: Voiced palatal plosive
symbols.description: Voiced oral stop produced with the body of the tongue against the hard palate.

symbols.name: Voiceless velar plosive
symbols.description: Voiceless oral stop produced with the tongue back against the soft palate (velum).

symbols.name: Voiced velar plosive
symbols.description: Voiced oral stop produced with the tongue back against the soft palate (velum).

symbols.name: Voiceless uvular plosive
symbols.description: Voiceless oral stop produced with the tongue back against the uvula.

symbols.name: Voiced uvular plosive
symbols.description: Voiced oral stop produced with the tongue back against the uvula.

symbols.name: Glottal stop
symbols.description: Plosive produced by full momentary closure of the vocal folds (glottis).

symbols.name: Voiced bilabial nasal
symbols.description: Voiced nasal stop produced with both lips.

symbols.name: Voiced labiodental nasal
symbols.description: Voiced nasal stop produced with the lower lip against the upper front teeth.

symbols.name: Voiced alveolar nasal
symbols.description: Voiced nasal stop produced at the alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Voiced retroflex nasal
symbols.description: Voiced nasal stop produced with tongue tip curled back.

symbols.name: Voiced palatal nasal
symbols.description: Voiced nasal stop produced with the tongue body against the hard palate.

symbols.name: Voiced velar nasal
symbols.description: Voiced nasal stop produced with the tongue back against the soft palate.

symbols.name: Voiced uvular nasal
symbols.description: Voiced nasal stop produced with the tongue back against the uvula.

symbols.name: Voiced bilabial trill
symbols.description: Voiced trill produced by vibrating the lips together.

symbols.name: Voiced alveolar trill
symbols.description: Voiced trill produced by vibrating the tongue tip against the alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Voiced uvular trill
symbols.description: Voiced trill produced by vibrating the uvula against the tongue back.

symbols.name: Voiced labiodental flap
symbols.description: Voiced flap produced by the lower lip striking the upper teeth.

symbols.name: Voiced alveolar tap
symbols.description: Voiced tap produced by a single contraction of the tongue tip striking the alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Voiced retroflex flap
symbols.description: Voiced flap produced by the curled tongue tip striking the alveolar ridge on release.

symbols.name: Voiceless bilabial fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless fricative produced by turbulent airflow between both lips.

symbols.name: Voiced bilabial fricative
symbols.description: Voiced fricative produced by airflow between both lips.

symbols.name: Voiceless labiodental fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless fricative produced with the lower lip against the upper teeth.

symbols.name: Voiced labiodental fricative
symbols.description: Voiced fricative produced with the lower lip against the upper teeth.

symbols.name: Voiceless dental fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless fricative produced with the tongue tip or blade against the upper front teeth.

symbols.name: Voiced dental fricative
symbols.description: Voiced fricative produced with the tongue tip or blade against the upper front teeth.

symbols.name: Voiceless alveolar fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless grooved sibilant fricative produced at the alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Voiced alveolar fricative
symbols.description: Voiced grooved sibilant fricative produced at the alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Voiceless postalveolar fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless domed/palato-alveolar sibilant fricative produced behind the alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Voiced postalveolar fricative
symbols.description: Voiced domed/palato-alveolar sibilant fricative produced behind the alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Voiceless retroflex fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless retroflex sibilant fricative produced with curled tongue tip.

symbols.name: Voiced retroflex fricative
symbols.description: Voiced retroflex sibilant fricative produced with curled tongue tip.

symbols.name: Voiceless palatal fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless non-sibilant fricative produced with the tongue body against the hard palate.

symbols.name: Voiced palatal fricative
symbols.description: Voiced non-sibilant fricative produced with the tongue body against the hard palate.

symbols.name: Voiceless velar fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless fricative produced with the tongue back against the soft palate.

symbols.name: Voiced velar fricative
symbols.description: Voiced fricative produced with the tongue back against the soft palate.

symbols.name: Voiceless uvular fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless fricative produced with the tongue back against the uvula.

symbols.name: Voiced uvular fricative
symbols.description: Voiced fricative or approximant produced with the tongue back against the uvula.

symbols.name: Voiceless pharyngeal fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless fricative produced by constriction in the lower pharynx.

symbols.name: Voiced pharyngeal fricative
symbols.description: Voiced constriction or approximant produced in the pharynx.

symbols.name: Voiceless glottal fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless whisper or breath friction produced at the vocal folds.

symbols.name: Voiced glottal fricative
symbols.description: Breathy voiced whisper or friction produced at the glottis.

symbols.name: Voiceless alveolar lateral fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless fricative produced with air escaping around the sides of the tongue.

symbols.name: Voiced alveolar lateral fricative
symbols.description: Voiced fricative produced with air escaping around the sides of the tongue.

symbols.name: Voiced labiodental approximant
symbols.description: Voiced approximant produced with the lower lip approaching the upper teeth without friction.

symbols.name: Voiced alveolar approximant
symbols.description: Voiced central approximant produced with the tongue tip near the alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Voiced retroflex approximant
symbols.description: Voiced approximant produced with the curled tongue tip near the palate.

symbols.name: Voiced palatal approximant
symbols.description: Voiced glide produced with the tongue body near the hard palate.

symbols.name: Voiced velar approximant
symbols.description: Voiced approximant produced with the tongue back near the velum without lip rounding.

symbols.name: Voiced alveolar lateral approximant
symbols.description: Voiced lateral approximant produced with the tongue tip at the alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Voiced retroflex lateral approximant
symbols.description: Voiced lateral approximant produced with curled tongue tip.

symbols.name: Voiced palatal lateral approximant
symbols.description: Voiced lateral approximant produced with the tongue body against the hard palate.

symbols.name: Voiced velar lateral approximant
symbols.description: Voiced lateral approximant produced with the tongue back against the soft palate.

symbols.description: Low front unrounded vowel produced with wide jaw opening.

symbols.name: Bilabial click
symbols.description: Bilabial suction click consonant produced with lips.

symbols.name: Dental click
symbols.description: Dental click consonant produced with tongue tip against teeth (tut-tut / tsk-tsk sound).

symbols.name: Post-alveolar click
symbols.description: Post-alveolar click consonant produced by popping release of tongue blade (hollow pop).

symbols.name: Palatoalveolar click
symbols.description: Sharp click consonant produced with tongue blade against hard palate.

symbols.name: Alveolar lateral click
symbols.description: Lateral click consonant produced with air entering along the sides of the tongue (horse-urging sound).

symbols.name: Voiced bilabial implosive
symbols.description: Voiced implosive oral stop produced with lowering glottis and bilabial closure.

symbols.name: Voiced alveolar implosive
symbols.description: Voiced implosive oral stop produced with lowering glottis at alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Voiced palatal implosive
symbols.description: Voiced implosive oral stop produced with lowering glottis at the hard palate.

symbols.name: Voiced velar implosive
symbols.description: Voiced implosive oral stop produced with lowering glottis at the velum.

symbols.name: Voiced uvular implosive
symbols.description: Voiced implosive oral stop produced with lowering glottis at the uvula.

symbols.name: Ejective modifier apostrophe
symbols.description: Glottalic airstream mechanism marker applied after stops or fricatives.

symbols.name: Bilabial ejective
symbols.description: Bilabial stop produced with closed rising glottis.

symbols.name: Alveolar ejective
symbols.description: Alveolar stop produced with closed rising glottis.

symbols.name: Velar ejective
symbols.description: Velar stop produced with closed rising glottis.

symbols.name: Alveolar ejective fricative
symbols.description: Alveolar fricative produced with ejective glottalic pressure.

symbols.name: Voiceless labial-velar fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless rounded velar fricative or approximant.

symbols.name: Voiced labial-velar approximant
symbols.description: Voiced rounded velar glide produced with lip rounding and raised tongue back.

symbols.name: Voiced labial-palatal approximant
symbols.description: Voiced approximant produced with lip rounding and tongue raised to hard palate.

symbols.name: Voiceless epiglottal fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless fricative produced with aryepiglottic folds constricted against the epiglottis.

symbols.name: Voiced epiglottal fricative
symbols.description: Voiced fricative produced by constriction between aryepiglottic folds and epiglottis.

symbols.name: Epiglottal plosive
symbols.description: Plosive produced by complete closure between the epiglottis and aryepiglottic folds.

symbols.name: Voiceless alveolo-palatal fricative
symbols.description: Voiceless sibilant fricative produced with tongue blade against alveolar ridge and palate.

symbols.name: Voiced alveolo-palatal fricative
symbols.description: Voiced sibilant fricative produced with tongue blade against alveolar ridge and palate.

symbols.name: Voiced alveolar lateral flap
symbols.description: Voiced lateral flap produced by tongue tip striking laterally against alveolar ridge.

symbols.name: Simultaneous voiceless postalveolar and velar fricative
symbols.description: Simultaneous voiceless postalveolar and velar fricative (Swedish sj-sound).

symbols.name: Combining double inverted breve (tie bar above)
symbols.description: Combining tie bar placed above two consonants to represent an affricate or double articulation.

symbols.name: Combining double breve below (tie bar below)
symbols.description: Combining tie bar placed below two consonants to represent an affricate or double articulation.

symbols.name: Combining ring below (voiceless)
symbols.description: Indicates that a voiced consonant or vowel is pronounced without vocal fold vibration.

symbols.name: Combining ring above (voiceless)
symbols.description: Indicates voicelessness when the base character has a descender.

symbols.name: Combining caron below (voiced)
symbols.description: Indicates that a voiceless consonant is produced with vocal fold vibration.

symbols.name: Modifier letter small h (aspirated)
symbols.description: Indicates a strong puff of air (aspiration) upon stop release.

symbols.name: Combining right half ring below (more rounded)
symbols.description: Indicates greater lip rounding.

symbols.name: Combining left half ring below (less rounded)
symbols.description: Indicates less lip rounding.

symbols.name: Combining plus sign below (advanced)
symbols.description: Indicates tongue position moved further forward in the vocal tract.

symbols.name: Combining minus sign below (retracted)
symbols.description: Indicates tongue position moved further back in the vocal tract.

symbols.name: Combining diaeresis (centralized)
symbols.description: Indicates that a front or back vowel is shifted toward the center of the vowel space.

symbols.name: Combining x above (mid-centralized)
symbols.description: Indicates that a vowel is shifted toward mid-central schwa [ə].

symbols.name: Combining vertical line below (syllabic)
symbols.description: Indicates that a consonant forms the nucleus of a syllable.

symbols.name: Combining inverted breve below (non-syllabic)
symbols.description: Indicates that a vowel is pronounced as a glide without forming a syllable nucleus.

symbols.name: Modifier letter rhotic hook
symbols.description: Indicates r-coloring (rhoticity) of a vowel.

symbols.name: Combining diaeresis below (breathy voiced)
symbols.description: Indicates breathy voice (murmur) with incomplete vocal fold closure.

symbols.name: Combining tilde below (creaky voiced)
symbols.description: Indicates creaky voice (vocal fry, laryngealization).

symbols.name: Combining seagull below (linguolabial)
symbols.description: Indicates contact between tongue tip/blade and the upper lip.

symbols.name: Modifier letter small w (labialized)
symbols.description: Indicates secondary lip rounding accompanying consonant production.

symbols.name: Modifier letter small j (palatalized)
symbols.description: Indicates secondary raising of tongue body toward hard palate (soft consonant).

symbols.name: Modifier letter small gamma (velarized)
symbols.description: Indicates secondary constriction of the tongue back toward the soft palate.

symbols.name: Modifier letter reversed glottal stop (pharyngealized)
symbols.description: Indicates secondary constriction in the pharynx (emphatic consonant).

symbols.name: Combining tilde overlay (velarized or pharyngealized)
symbols.description: Indicates velarization or pharyngealization overlay through the character body.

symbols.name: Combining up tack below (raised)
symbols.description: Indicates that the body of the tongue is raised higher than canonical position.

symbols.name: Combining down tack below (lowered)
symbols.description: Indicates that the body of the tongue is positioned lower than canonical position.

symbols.name: Combining left tack below (advanced tongue root / +ATR)
symbols.description: Indicates advancement of the tongue root forward (+ATR).

symbols.name: Combining right tack below (retracted tongue root / -ATR)
symbols.description: Indicates retraction of the tongue root backward (-ATR).

symbols.name: Combining bridge below (dental)
symbols.description: Indicates that an alveolar consonant is produced against the teeth.

symbols.name: Combining inverted bridge below (apical)
symbols.description: Indicates that a consonant is articulated using the tip of the tongue.

symbols.name: Combining square below (laminal)
symbols.description: Indicates that a consonant is articulated using the flat blade of the tongue.

symbols.name: Combining tilde (nasalized)
symbols.description: Indicates lowered velum allowing air to escape through the nasal cavity during vowel production.

symbols.name: Superscript n (nasal release)
symbols.description: Indicates that an oral stop is released through the nose rather than the mouth.

symbols.name: Modifier letter small l (lateral release)
symbols.description: Indicates that an oral stop is released around the sides of the tongue.

symbols.name: Combining left angle above (no audible release)
symbols.description: Indicates that an oral plosive is not audibly released at the end of a syllable.

symbols.name: Modifier letter vertical line (primary stress)
symbols.description: Placed before the syllable that bears primary prominence or stress.

symbols.name: Modifier letter low vertical line (secondary stress)
symbols.description: Placed before a syllable bearing secondary prominence or stress.

symbols.name: Modifier letter triangular colon (long)
symbols.description: Indicates extended duration or length of preceding vowel or consonant.

symbols.name: Modifier letter half triangular colon (half-long)
symbols.description: Indicates intermediate duration between short and full long.

symbols.name: Combining breve (extra-short)
symbols.description: Indicates that a segment is articulated with exceptionally short duration.

symbols.name: Full stop (syllable break)
symbols.description: Explicit separator denoting boundary between adjacent syllables.

symbols.name: Vertical line (minor foot group)
symbols.description: Denotes a minor prosodic boundary, prosodic foot, or brief pause.

symbols.name: Double vertical line (major intonation group)
symbols.description: Denotes a major intonation break, clausal division, or full pause.

symbols.name: Undertie (linking / absence of a break)
symbols.description: Connects words to show continuous pronunciation without an intervening pause.

symbols.name: Modifier letter extra-high tone bar
symbols.description: Chao tone letter indicating pitch level 5 (extra-high).

symbols.name: Modifier letter high tone bar
symbols.description: Chao tone letter indicating pitch level 4 (high).

symbols.name: Modifier letter mid tone bar
symbols.description: Chao tone letter indicating pitch level 3 (mid).

symbols.name: Modifier letter low tone bar
symbols.description: Chao tone letter indicating pitch level 2 (low).

symbols.name: Modifier letter extra-low tone bar
symbols.description: Chao tone letter indicating pitch level 1 (extra-low).

symbols.name: Rising tone bar sequence (1 to 5)
symbols.description: Contour tone rising from extra-low to extra-high.

symbols.name: Falling tone bar sequence (5 to 1)
symbols.description: Contour tone falling from extra-high to extra-low.

symbols.name: Combining acute accent (high tone)
symbols.description: Accented diacritic marking high pitch level or primary tone.

symbols.name: Combining grave accent (low tone)
symbols.description: Accented diacritic marking low pitch level.

symbols.name: Combining macron (mid tone)
symbols.description: Accented diacritic marking mid level pitch.

symbols.name: Combining double acute accent (extra-high tone)
symbols.description: Accented diacritic marking extra-high pitch level.

symbols.name: Combining double grave accent (extra-low tone)
symbols.description: Accented diacritic marking extra-low pitch level.

symbols.name: Combining caron (rising tone)
symbols.description: Accented diacritic marking low-to-high rising contour tone.

symbols.name: Combining circumflex accent (falling tone)
symbols.description: Accented diacritic marking high-to-low falling contour tone.

symbols.name: Modifier letter downstep
symbols.description: Indicates a pitch drop or downstep in register across tones.

symbols.name: Modifier letter upstep
symbols.description: Indicates a pitch rise or upstep in register across tones.

symbols.name: North east arrow (global rise)
symbols.description: Indicates intonational global rise in pitch over an utterance.

symbols.name: South east arrow (global fall)
symbols.description: Indicates intonational global fall in pitch over an utterance.
